threshold_selection: Fixed DeepSlide default; not tuned on this dataset.

label_method.presence: USGS v3 inventory POINT buffered to 40 m radius as positive pixels inside 128x128@10m chip centered on the point
label_method.absence: Same 5-degree-block catalog pseudo-absences when available; otherwise synthesized points in-block ≥5 km from any USGS presence. All-zero masks.
label_method.limitation: Point inventories are not scar polygons; pixel metrics vs circular buffers are approximate. Chip-level detection is the primary metric.

geography.independence_basis: USGS CONUS points are outside documented L4S Asia study areas

split.method: spatial 5-degree blocks; hold out entire blocks for evaluation only (no training/tuning)

chip_positive_rule: chip labelled positive if inventory presence; prediction positive if any pixel score>0.5 inside the 40m buffer (presence) or anywhere (absence → FP if any)
secondary_pixel_metrics: reported vs buffer masks but do not alone determine PASS/FAIL
scientific_validation_claim: Even if numeric gates pass, results remain limited by point-buffer labels and are NOT full scar-level scientific validation.
